trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No extra task, no final fight. Work the roadmap in order and the platinum lands with the last trophy you finish.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission. Play it through, follow the prompts, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter closes itself once its last mission is done. Check the pause menu if you want to see what is left.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Same deal as Chapter 1: the last mission of the chapter triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. That is the whole job. One mission, one gold trophy, and the story is done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so play the story until it appears, then finish it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission: do it when the chance comes.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story until the heist unlocks, then complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story mission. Play until it appears and complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story mission. Play until it appears and complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission. Play until it appears and complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission. Play until it appears and complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion. That means every mission, every collectible set, every activity and every side strand. Use the in-game stats page to see what is left. This is the long grind, and it usually pops right before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Any jump, near miss, drift or airtime counts toward the total. Stunts stack up fast during normal driving, so just play and watch the counter. A stunt-heavy session in a fast car clears the rest.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Fishing, racing, arcade, shooting range, drone racing, hunting, bowling, meditation and challenges. One try each is enough. You do not need to win.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold time or score. Learn the pattern of each one, then go for gold one at a time. The range is in the activities list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race. Win them all, one by one. The drone handles like a remote control car, so take the corners wide and cut the straight lines.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones. Work through the race list and tick them off.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, and out-fish him. Keep the line tension steady and reel when the fish tires.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a machine, and finish a full game. It does not matter which machine or how well you score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand ends with one last job. Play his missions until the final one appears, then complete it. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern: play Kenton's strand to its end and complete the last mission. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand to its end and complete the last mission. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers show up as icons on the map. Follow each strand to its end. You need 8 of them done, and there are more than 8 to find.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to its end and complete the last mission. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand to its end and complete the last mission. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are marked once you find them. Visit each one and meditate. A full tour of the map covers most of them.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret points you at one specific animal. Track it, get close, and take it down. The hunt is the whole job.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida. Each set needs its own cards. Collect them, complete 3 full sets, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK It spots are all over the map. Hit 100 of them. A slow drive through town with the app open racks them up.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks. Any 50 will do, and they add up during normal play. Check the challenges list to see which are close.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the cops to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies. Do it with your partner nearby or it will not count. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present at the right moment.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Three shops in a row, partner with you, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a route through three close shops. Flagged missable because it needs your partner and a live wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any vehicle you get into for the first time counts. Drive everything you see. A tour of parking lots and dealerships fills the list fast.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with 5 enemies in view and drop all 5 before it ends. A crowded firefight is the best place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport and leave in a way the airport did not schedule. A stolen plane off the runway does the job. Flagged missable because it is a one-time moment at a specific place.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos. The Rhinos are tanks, and the trophy is about taking one on. Find a tank, survive the encounter, and do what the moment asks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, no alarms, no witnesses. Plan the entry, move slow, and leave before anyone notices. Flagged missable because one alarm ruins the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways. Each vault is its own job, so plan them one at a time and get out before the cops close in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away. The truck is the target, the escape is the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area on the map. The map fills in as you go, and the last area pops the trophy.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang, nine gangs total. Each gang has its own turf, so work through the map gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and order a cocktail. Simple, but easy to walk past. Flagged missable because it is a specific place and moment.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom front. The messier the exit, the better. Flagged missable because it is a one-time smash at a specific place.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and finish a game. It is a specific place, so check the map for Kolt & Associates. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about a moment with your partner that the crowd loves. Play the partner missions and watch for the moment. Flagged missable because it is a one-time moment.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This tracks the choices you make in the story. PSN counts them up to 500. Keep playing the story and making choices, and the trophy pops when the count is reached. Flagged missable because some choices only come once.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time is the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try. The trophy is about the comeback, so a retry that lands is what counts. Flagged missable because it needs a fail followed by a win.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida. Go looking for the odd and the unexplained, and this pops when you find it. Flagged missable because the strange event only happens once.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. A melee hit from a moving vehicle, bowling style. Line up a target, drive past, and swing. Flagged missable because it needs a moving vehicle and a clean melee hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies. Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It adds up over time.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop, any purchase. $100,000 total. Cars, clothes, weapons, it all counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale around Leonida. Buy all 8. They are also useful, so this one pays for itself.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles. Open the Scooter Bros app, register them, and the trophy pops at 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
